ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: "ILLINOIS BACH ACADEMY." This course will meet June 20-25 only. The course offering is 1-4 variable credit hours. The workshop will begin at 6:00 PM on June 20 and conclude after the evening concert on June 25. Spend a week studying, rehearsing, and performing works of Johann Sebastian Bach with some of America's leading experts in Baroque music. Violinist Nancy Wilson and conductor Andrew Megill lead the faculty. The week will end with a performance with a period instrument orchestra. Other faculty include Baroque violinist Leah Nelson and Fuma Sacra, a professional vocal ensemble whose performances of Baroque and Renaissance music have "left the audience gasping in amazement." Some experience as a choral singer is necessary, however, the week is designed for amateur as well as professional singers. For more information, visit https://publish.illinois.edu/bachacademy/.
